story.title: Mira and the Golden Lantern
story.storyText:
Once upon a time, a young girl named Mira lived in a small village beside a mysterious forest. One evening, while walking home, she noticed a tiny golden light glowing beneath an old oak tree. Curious, Mira stepped closer and discovered a little lantern lying among the leaves.

As soon as she picked it up, the lantern whispered, “Please help me find my way home.”

Mira was surprised, but she was not afraid. She asked the lantern where its home was, and it pointed toward the deepest part of the forest. Carrying it carefully, Mira followed the winding path beneath the tall trees.

Along the way, she met a frightened rabbit caught between two fallen branches. Mira stopped to help and gently freed it. The rabbit happily followed her, hopping beside her as they continued their journey.

Soon, they reached a beautiful clearing where hundreds of tiny lights floated in the air. The lantern suddenly began to glow brighter.

“This is my home,” it said.

Mira placed the lantern beneath a glowing tree, and instantly it joined the other magical lights, filling the forest with a warm golden glow.

The next morning, Mira returned to her village with the rabbit beside her. From that day onward, whenever she looked toward the forest at night, she could see one especially bright light shining among the trees.

She knew the little lantern had never forgotten her kindness.

story.title: Leo's Kindness Saves a Friend
story.storyText: A little fox named Leo lived near a quiet forest. One day, he found a small bird that had hurt its wing. Leo gently carried the bird to a safe place. He brought it food and stayed beside it every day. After a few days, the bird became healthy again. It flew away happily and thanked Leo. Leo learned that kindness can make a big difference.

story.storyText: Sara was walking home when dark clouds filled the sky. Rain began to fall. She saw a small boy standing alone under a tree, looking scared. story.title: Ben's Blooming Patience
story.storyText: Ben the bear found a tiny seed near the river. He planted it beside his home and watered it every day. At first, nothing happened. Ben waited patiently and kept caring for the soil. One sunny morning, a green sprout appeared. Days later, it grew into a bright yellow flower with a sweet smell. Bees and butterflies came to visit. Ben smiled and learned that good things grow with time and care.

story.title: The Honest Woodcutter's Gift
story.storyText:
A woodcutter accidentally dropped his axe into a river. A magical spirit appeared and offered him a golden axe and a silver axe. The woodcutter refused, saying they weren’t his. Impressed by his honesty, the spirit gave him all three axes.

Moral: Honesty is always rewarded.

story.title: Ravi's Kindness Saves All
story.storyText:
In a forest lived a big elephant named Ravi.
He was very strong but also very kind.

One hot day, many animals were thirsty because the small pond had dried up.
The elephant used his strong trunk to dig the ground.

Soon, water started coming out of the soil.
All the animals happily drank the water.

They thanked the elephant for helping them.

story.title: Lily's Leaf Kitchen
story.storyText:
In a small garden, there was a tiny plant named Lily. Lily loved the sunshine.

One day, a curious butterfly asked, “Lily, you don’t go to the kitchen like humans. How do you get your food”

Lily smiled and said, “I make my own food”

The butterfly was surprised. “How”

Lily explained, “My leaves are like a little kitchen. I take sunlight from the sun, water from the soil, and carbon dioxide from the air.”

“And then” asked the butterfly.

“My leaves mix them together and make food for me. This process is called photosynthesis,” Lily said proudly.

The butterfly said, “Wow So the sun is your chef”

Lily laughed. “Yes And my leaves are the cooks.”

From that day on, the butterfly told all the garden animals about Lily’s amazing leaf kitchen.

And that is how plants make their own food
